title: VIXEN UI target tests need a canonical staged-asset working directory
body: The queued focused UI binaries failed with exit 139 when launched from the worktree root because CMake stages assets/ui next to the test executable and RmlUi resolves relative paths from the process CWD. Running the same binaries from .tmp/build/libraries/RenderGraph/tests passed. Provide a target wrapper or test registration that selects the executable directory automatically, so a lane cannot mistake a working-directory asset lookup failure for a product red.
